ASSET: Sweet Home 3D / Scopia "Acacia" (acacia) - small tree with pinnate (fern-like) foliage, tropical look
CATEGORY: vegetation -> SM_BroadTree_C (small ornamental/garden tree ~6 m; 7.7 x 6.5 x 6.5 m as authored) or a tropical
          alternative for SM_BroadTree_A when scaled up.
